# Text outline reference

Original fixture generated by `tools/text_outline_fixture.py`, with Arial text,
a 0.75pt centered solid teal outline, and white/yellow ordinary text fills.
Cases cover direct outline properties, inherited character style, direct fill
color overriding the character style, and outlined text in adjacent table cells.

`native.pdf` was exported read-only by the reference application. The reviewed
one-page output retains both table columns and the teal outlines; yellow fill
remains visible inside the directly colored case. No corpus assets are included.

Before outline support this fixture produced a read-only flattened preview.
It now exercises the outline renderer and preservation path. The control does
not establish a reference/spec divergence; themed color resolution has a separate
unit check and corpus comparison.

The outline implementation restores editable table layout. Its tests compare
all baselines and non-table origins with the native glyph reference, and verify
outline strokes plus editing/export/undo. The minimal table's text is about
5.25pt to the right of the reference application: a private control with all outlines removed and
ordinary black text reproduces the same offset (Left 5.246pt, Right 5.200pt).
This independent default-table positioning defect remains open; the browser
check does not assert native horizontal origins for those two table labels.
The fixture is not a claim of complete layout fidelity.
